'''Keshk''' was<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi" /> a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> [[Flesh Raider]] who held the position of [[Grand Chieftain]] among the Flesh Raider [[Species/Legends|species]] on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A [[Color/Legends|black]]-skinned Flesh Raider with white markings who stood twice as tall as others of their race, the red-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] Keshk carried a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] into battle while wearing [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. Keshk's people were organized into an [[Flesh Raider army|army]] by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]]<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi" /> around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> and the Grand Chieftain made a camp<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi" /> in the northern part of the ruins of the ancient [[City/Legends|city]] [[Kaleth]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
However, Keshk was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an individual affiliated with the Republic at some point during the [[Flesh Raider uprising|conflict]] between the Flesh Raiders and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Keshk first appeared in the [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a high-level boss on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Tython, the starting world for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and [[Jedi Consular|Consular]] classes, where they can be fought by both classes in their respective finale missions. However, any Republic player class&mdash;[[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]], [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]], [[Voidhound|Smuggler]], or [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Trooper]]&mdash;can kill Keshk when visiting Tython. Since this article was written with the assumption of 100 percent game completion, this article states that Keshk was killed but does not specify an individual. While not specified in-game, Keshk's character model is labeled as male.<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi" /> Keshk's location was also labeled in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''.<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
